_about: 1-Pentanol (1) + Cyclohexane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-pentanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-pentanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: G. Ovejero, M. D. Romero, E. Diez, T. Lopes, I. Diaz, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium for the Binary Systems 1-Pentanol + Cyclohexane and 1-Pentanol + n-Hexane at Low Alcohol Compositions, J. Chem. Eng. Data 52 (2007) 1984-1987
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0051. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
